exposure_anchors.1: Negligible: domestic-only services, no physical goods, no controlled tech.
exposure_anchors.2: Limited: occasional EU exports of clearly non-controlled goods.
exposure_anchors.3: Moderate: regular international shipments; some dual-use risk.
exposure_anchors.4: High: dual-use product line; international distribution including emerging markets; foreign-national engineering team.
exposure_anchors.5: Severe: defence / encryption / advanced-materials / sensitive-tech sector; supply chain into sanctioned-adjacent jurisdictions.

threat_credibility_anchors.1: No documented enforcement in this profile.
threat_credibility_anchors.3: Active enforcement in the sector (BIS, ECJU, customs raids).
threat_credibility_anchors.4: Active and adapted: peers prosecuted; sector named in enforcement bulletins.
threat_credibility_anchors.5: Active and targeted: prior enforcement contact or sector listed as priority.

vulnerability_anchors.1: Programme complete: classification, end-user screening, licence tracking, deemed-export, training, audit.
vulnerability_anchors.2: Programme broadly in place with minor gaps.
vulnerability_anchors.3: Programme partial: classification inconsistent; deemed-export weak.
vulnerability_anchors.4: Programme weak: end-user screening absent; supply chain unverified.
vulnerability_anchors.5: No programme; reliance on customer self-declaration.
